0022600215.text: The Magic (2-7) are 0-4 at home and 2-3 on the road, have lost four straight, and sit 12th in the East and fifth in the Southeast, 4 games back. The Kings (1-8) are 0-4 at home and 1-4 on the road, have lost two straight, and sit 15th in the West and fifth in the Pacific, 6.5 games back. Orlando will be without Desmond Bane (illness), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Sacramento will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after the Magic won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 121-117 win in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
